title: S2B_func_denoise QC Status
description: QC status schema for the optional S2B MP-PCA thermal-noise denoising step (aggregated per dataset key). When denoising is disabled the step is a clean passthrough: status PASS, enabled false, runs empty.

bids_root.description: Absolute path to the BIDS root the BOLD series were read from.

status.description: Aggregate status across all runs in this dataset.

enabled.description: Whether denoising actually ran. false = clean passthrough (no outputs; chain advances using the raw BOLD).

counts.description: Run tallies. The passthrough case reports total/pass/fail = 0.

failure_message.description: Aggregate failure / passthrough note (null when all runs passed).

denoise.description: Provenance returned by lib/denoise.mppca_denoise (the dwidenoise call).

nthreads.description: Thread cap passed via -nthreads (dwidenoise ignores OMP_NUM_THREADS).

extent.description: Denoising patch extent: 'auto' or an explicit NxNxN.

error.description: Present only when the dwidenoise call failed.

metrics.description: Step-local metrics. tSNR gain (in-tissue median) is the truth metric; residual_structure_corr guards against over-denoising.

residual_structure_corr.description: corr(temporal-SD of removed signal, mean image). Structureless is good; WARN > warn_residual_corr, FAIL > fail_residual_corr.

reportlets.description: Relative paths to the 3 QC figures (present on PASS/WARN).
